接口 Damageable

public interface Damageable extends Entity
Represents an Entity that has health and can take damage. 表示拥有生命值且可以受到伤害的 Entity。

    • setMaxHealth

      void setMaxHealth(double health)
      Sets the maximum health this entity can have. 设置该实体可拥有的最大生命值。

      If the health of the entity is above the value provided it will be set to that value. 如果该实体的生命值高于所提供的值，它将被设为该值。

      Note: An entity with a health bar (Player, EnderDragon, Wither, etc...} will have their bar scaled accordingly. 注意：带有生命值条的实体（Player、EnderDragon、Wither 等）的生命值条将相应地缩放。

      参数:
      health - amount of health to set the maximum to 要设置的最大生命值
